personal_info.summary: Full-stack Software Developer with 3 years of experience specializing in building scalable and high-performance applications. Expert in frontend development using React, Vue.js, and Next.js, and backend development with NestJS. Proven track record in delivering seamless eCommerce solutions and integrating complex third-party services. Strong focus on user-centric design, quality assurance, and maintaining stability across platforms. Adept in working in Agile teams, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, user-friendly applications. Passionate about solving complex challenges and continually improving technical skills to deliver impactful solutions.

responsibilities: Developed eCommerce solutions for multiple vehicle brands using React and GraphQL, ensuring a dynamic and user-friendly experience.
Ensured high product quality and stability while adapting to feature changes, maintaining a consistent experience across various brand-specific sites.
Implemented automated testing with Cypress, ensuring reliable functionality and minimizing errors across the platform.
Developed a full-stack solution as an intermediary for government services, ensuring seamless integration with third-party systems.
Implemented robust error handling, synchronization, and response management, ensuring reliable data flow and system stability.
Collaborated with internal and external teams to optimize performance, manage complex workflows, and ensure compliance with strict requirements.
Developed web and mobile applications using React, Vue.js, and Ionic, ensuring seamless, high-quality, and responsive user experiences across platforms.
Built backend services with NestJS, focusing on secure, efficient loan processing workflows and maintaining strict quality and performance standards.
Collaborated in a Scrum environment using GitFlow, ensuring smooth integration of features, efficient delivery, and a consistent user experience across the application.
Developed pixel-perfect web applications based on Figma designs, ensuring high-quality visual consistency across different devices and screen sizes.
Took ownership of front-end decisions, including selecting technologies, building complex layouts, and implementing animations.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver responsive, user-friendly websites, balancing design precision with technical execution.
